# CSSLv3 + LoA-Engine Co-Design : Research Synthesis

## §F foundational-findings

**F1 • ¬existing-lang-fits**
○ Mojo = closest-philosophy (unified CPU+GPU, comptime-dispatch) ✓ but Python-syntax + LLVM-locked ✗
○ Jai/Odin/Zig = CPU-only data-oriented ✓ but GPU = bolt-on-shaders ✗
○ Slang/Circle = unified-shader-spec ✓ but C++-host-bound ✗
▽ gap-confirmed : no lang does (CPU+GPU unified) ∧ (engine-primitives=lang-primitives) ∧ (hw-first) ∧ (consent-as-OS-compatible)

**F2 • SPIR-V = target-IR W!**
‼ Vulkan-1.3 consumes SPIR-V natively ✓
‼ DirectX SM7 adopting SPIR-V (2026+) → future-portability ✓
◐ LLVM-SPIR-V-backend official since LLVM-20 (Jan-2025) — ∃ reference-impl if needed
W! CSSLv3 emits SPIR-V directly ¬ via LLVM (avoid dep-hell, keep compactness) → hand-rolled SPIR-V emitter ∼2-3K LOC

**F3 • x86-64 backend = hand-rolled W!**
○ Zig-model : bundle-LLVM = 50MB+ toolchain ✗ violates "Gameboy-cartridge" § 
○ Onramp-model : bootstrap-via-bytecode → native-emit = 500-2000 LOC per backend ✓
W! CSSLv3-x86-64 = direct AVX2-aware codegen, ¬ LLVM, SystemV-ABI

**F4 • bindless = lang-native primitive**
▲ Vulkan-1.3 core: buffer_device_address + descriptor_indexing → GPU-pointers ≡ CPU-pointers (both uint64) 
I> CSSLv3 primitive: `gpu*T` type ≡ CPU `*T` at ABI-level → shared-pointer-semantics across CPU/GPU
→ §lang-engine-unification : same `Mesh` struct readable on both sides, no marshaling, no duplicate-decl

## §B bootstrap-strategy

**3-stage • Onramp/Rust-model**
Stage-0 = CSSLv3-bootstrap-compiler in Rust (throwaway)
  • subset : structs, fns, pointers, loops, ifs, `@[redacted:email]` annotations, SPIR-V+x86-64 emit
  • ~8-15K LOC Rust
  • covers CSSLv3-minimal sufficient for Stage-1
Stage-1 = CSSLv3-compiler written in CSSLv3-minimal, compiled by Stage-0
  • adds : comptime-eval, generics, reflection, error-handling, full-SIMD-intrinsics
  • validates self-host
Stage-2 = CSSLv3-full compiled by Stage-1 ≡ Stage-1 → fixed-point ✓
  • now Stage-0 = archived, never-touched-again (throwaway complete)

R! once self-hosted : Rust-repo = deletable ∴ lang-sovereignty

## §L lang-engine-unified-primitives

these are lang-level W!, ¬ stdlib — engine can't exist without them, lang can't exist without them :

**L1 • substrate-types**
• `field<T, N>` = N-dim SIMD-aligned array (AVX2-256=8xf32, 4xf64) — primitive ¬ library
• `chunk<T, 32³>` = voxel-chunk, palette-compressed at ABI-level
• `sdf` = SDF-function type, auto-differentiable at comptime

**L2 • locality-annotations**
• `[redacted:social-handle] fn` / `[redacted:social-handle] fn` / `[redacted:social-handle] fn` — comptime-dispatch like Mojo but lang-native
• `[redacted:social-handle]` fn auto-lowers to SPIR-V compute, `[redacted:social-handle]` generates both
• shared struct `Mesh { pos: gpu*vec3, idx: gpu*u32 }` — same decl, both sides

**L3 • material-as-first-class**
• engine needs `MaterialDef` w/ 30+ physical properties (per GDD)
• lang primitive: `mat T { density: f32, hardness: f32, ... }` → compiles to SoA on CPU, SSBO on GPU automatically
• ∴ "everything is material" enforced at type-system level

**L4 • consent-as-OS @ type-level**
• effect-system lang-feature : `fn harm() !Consent` requires caller proof
• PRIME-DIRECTIVE = compile-time-gate ¬ convention
• I> this is load-bearing : lang refuses to compile code that violates consent-architecture ≡ Ouroboroid-framework

**L5 • fields-not-entities**
• ¬ ECS-archetype model • voxel-substrate = field-native (M/S/P three-layer from Substrate-v2)
• `field` primitive subsumes component-arrays • system = fn over fields
• SIMD-auto-vectorization comptime because field-layout is lang-knowable

## §H hw-abstraction-layer

```
CSSLv3-source
    ↓ parse → AST → CSLv3-semantic-IR (dense notation-level)
    ↓ lower → CSSLv3-core-IR (typed, SSA, effect-annotated)
    ↓ split by [redacted:social-handle] / [redacted:social-handle] annotation
    ↓         ↓
  CPU-IR   GPU-IR
    ↓         ↓
  x86-64    SPIR-V  ← bound to Vulkan-1.3 + AVX2
  AVX2      1.6
    ↓         ↓
  ELF/PE   .spv modules
```

future-hw-ports : add new backend at split-point ; core-IR unchanged ; lang unchanged

## §T toolchain-minimum

• compiler : self-hosted, single binary, <5MB target
• build-system = part of lang (Jai/Zig-model) — no external scripts
• SPIR-V tools : hand-rolled validator (copy khronos-spec) — ~1K LOC
• Vulkan-1.3 bindings : lang-native FFI to libvulkan.so.1 / vulkan-1.dll
• x86-64 emitter : encode-tables from Intel-SDM directly, no external asm

## §R risks • anti-patterns

‼ R1 : scope-creep — "lang does everything" = 10-year-project
  M? mitigation : Stage-0 ships in 3-6mo, lang-minimal-complete before engine-features grow
‼ R2 : SPIR-V semantic-mismatch (per Intel-LLVM-talk, real-pain-point)
  M? mitigation : subset SPIR-V to Shader+PhysicalStorageBuffer64 only, ignore OpenCL-Kernel caps
‼ R3 : AVX2-vs-AVX-512 split — target-machine is AVX2-only ✓ lock-in now, AVX-512 later
‼ R4 : bootstrap-stuck in Rust — psychological trap ; throwaway-discipline W!
